rundown: Gators beat Mountaineers 85-72 at Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas, NV. Gators led 40-30 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 75%).
Leading the way — Gators: Thomas Haugh 22 pts; Denzel Aberdeen 5 ast; Jones Lay 7 reb. Mountaineers: Miles Sadler 18 pts; Finley Bizjack 2 ast; Mouhamed Sylla 6 reb.
Where Gators won it: they shot 58% to 43%, shot 50% from three to 32% and won the boards 35-23.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Gators closed as 8.5-point favorites and covered by 4.5; the total closed at 147.5 and they combined for 157, over by 9.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 2:23 PM ET. It had Gators 68% and Mountaineers 32%, projecting Gators 78.3 – Mountaineers 73.2 (151.4 total, Gators by 5.1).

Final: Gators 85 – Mountaineers 72. Right winner: it had Gators at 68%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Gators came in with a 16% above average attack and a 12% stingier than average defense (5-1, 81.8 scored and 69 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 190 and 193 games of evidence. Projected to score 78.3, they scored 85 (+6.7 points, 9% over); projected to allow 73.2, they allowed 72 (−1.2 points, 2% under).

Mountaineers came in with a 6% above average attack and a 12% stingier than average defense (4-1, 83 scored and 63.2 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 185 and 186 games of evidence. Projected to score 73.2, they scored 72 (−1.2 points, 2% under); projected to allow 78.3, they allowed 85 (+6.7 points, 9% over).

The bigger miss was Gators' scoring (+6.7 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 157 against 151.4 projected (+5.6), about the 65th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Gators by 13 against Gators by 5.1 projected, about the 24th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Mountaineers ×1.02, Gators ×1.00. It favored Mountaineers, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
WVU ML (+300) at +300: the algo gave it 24% vs 24% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 23%). FLA ML (-380) at -380: the algo gave it 76% vs 76% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 77%). WVU +7.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing +8.5 by 1. FLA -7.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing -8.5 by 1. OVER 147.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 147.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Mountaineers +7.5 → +8.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 59% of bets on Gators, 38% of the money — Gators covered; total: 87% of bets on the over, 77% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 96% of bets on Gators, 93% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Mountaineers, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.016 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 778 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Gators attack ×1.007, defense ×0.993 (6 games); Mountaineers attack ×1.001, defense ×0.998 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
